title: Generation Utilities Module
summary: This module provides comprehensive functionalities for text generation, including various decoding strategies like greedy, sampling, beam search, and assisted decoding. It also supports continuous batching, input preparation, and managing generation configurations and state.

nodes.label: User Input & Params
nodes.title: User Input
nodes.description: Provides initial prompts, input IDs, and various generation parameters to control the output.

nodes.label: Model Configuration
nodes.title: Model Config
nodes.description: Defines the underlying model's architecture and default generation settings, influencing how tokens are processed and generated.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: Tokenizer
nodes.description: Converts raw text into numerical token IDs and vice-versa. Essential for processing prompts and decoding generated sequences, also used for token healing.

nodes.label: Assistant Model
nodes.title: Assistant Model
nodes.description: A smaller, faster model used in assisted decoding to propose candidate token sequences, accelerating the generation process of the main model.

nodes.label: Main Generation API
nodes.title: Generation Entry Point
nodes.description: The primary interface (`GenerationMixin.generate`) for initiating text generation, orchestrating various decoding strategies and parameter handling.

nodes.label: Continuous Batching API
nodes.title: Continuous Batching
nodes.description: Provides an interface (`ContinuousMixin.generate_batch`) for efficient, continuous processing of multiple generation requests in a batch.

nodes.label: Generation Configuration
nodes.title: Generation Config
nodes.description: An object that consolidates and manages all parameters governing the generation process, such as `max_length`, `num_beams`, and `do_sample`.

nodes.label: Prepare Model Inputs
nodes.title: Input Preparation
nodes.description: Formats and preprocesses input tensors, including attention masks and position IDs, ensuring they are ready for the model's forward pass.

nodes.label: Manage KV Cache
nodes.title: KV Cache Management
nodes.description: Handles the key-value cache, storing past attention states to optimize sequential token generation and reduce redundant computations.

nodes.label: Execute Model Forward
nodes.title: Model Forward Pass
nodes.description: Executes the core model's forward pass with the prepared inputs, producing raw logits for the next token and updated hidden states.

nodes.label: Apply Logits Processors
nodes.title: Logits Processing
nodes.description: Modifies the raw logits using various strategies like temperature scaling, top-k filtering, and repetition penalties to influence token selection.

nodes.label: Select Next Tokens
nodes.title: Token Selection
nodes.description: Chooses the next token(s) based on the applied decoding strategy, such as greedy selection, multinomial sampling, or beam search.

nodes.label: Check Stopping Criteria
nodes.title: Stopping Criteria
nodes.description: Evaluates conditions (e.g., maximum length reached, end-of-sequence token generated) to determine if the generation process should terminate.

nodes.label: Update Model State
nodes.title: State Update
nodes.description: Updates the internal model state, including the generated sequence and other relevant parameters, for the subsequent generation step.

nodes.label: Generated Sequences
nodes.title: Output Sequences
nodes.description: The final output of the generation process, consisting of the complete sequence of token IDs or decoded text.

nodes.label: Continuous Batch Manager
nodes.title: Batch Manager
nodes.description: An internal manager that handles the lifecycle of continuous batching requests, from adding prompts to retrieving results.

nodes.label: Candidate Generator
nodes.title: Candidate Generation
nodes.description: Generates speculative candidate token sequences, primarily used in assisted decoding to speed up the verification process.

nodes.label: Perform Token Healing
nodes.title: Token Healing
nodes.description: Adjusts the input token sequence to ensure valid continuations, particularly useful for subword tokenizers to prevent malformed tokens.

nodes.label: Sampling Decoding
nodes.title: Sampling Decoding
nodes.description: Implements multinomial sampling, top-k, top-p, and other probabilistic methods to generate diverse and creative text sequences.

nodes.label: Beam Search Decoding
nodes.title: Beam Search Decoding
nodes.description: Explores multiple high-probability sequences simultaneously, aiming to find a globally optimal sequence by maintaining a 'beam' of candidates.

nodes.label: Assisted Decoding
nodes.title: Assisted Decoding
nodes.description: A decoding method that leverages a smaller, faster assistant model to predict and verify candidate tokens, accelerating the generation process.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: Surface API
groups.description: User-facing methods for initiating generation, providing high-level control over the process.

groups.label: Generation Core Logic
groups.title: Generation Core
groups.description: The central loop and mechanisms for token generation, including input preparation, model execution, and token selection.

groups.label: Decoding Strategies
groups.title: Decoding Strategies
groups.description: Implementations of various token selection algorithms, each offering different trade-offs between output quality and diversity.

groups.label: Configuration & State Management
groups.title: Config & State
groups.description: Components responsible for managing generation parameters, internal model state, and optimizing resource usage during generation.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Internal Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions for specific generation tasks, such as ensuring valid token sequences or optimizing model behavior.
